title: Every Eight Minutes: Uber’s Alarming Sexual Violence Problem

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界，充实度过每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: These hats are available for a limited time as a thank you gift to people who purchase a new annual New York Times audio subscription.
sentences.zh: 这些帽子限时赠送，作为对购买《纽约时报》年度音频订阅新用户的感谢礼。

sentences.en: They're black.
sentences.zh: 它们是黑色的。

sentences.en: They say hard fork on them.
sentences.zh: 上面写着“硬分叉”（Hard Fork）。

sentences.en: They're very pretty.
sentences.zh: 它们非常漂亮。

sentences.en: And our audio subscription supports shows like ours as well as shows like The Daily,
sentences.zh: 我们的音频订阅不仅支持像我们这样的节目，也支持像《每日新闻》（The Daily）这样的节目，

sentences.en: The Ezra Klein Show, Modern Love, and Cannonball, the new Wesley Morris Show.
sentences.zh: 还有《埃兹拉·克莱恩秀》（The Ezra Klein Show）、《现代爱情》（Modern Love）以及韦斯利·莫里斯（Wesley Morris）的新节目《炮弹》（Cannonball）。

sentences.en: So please, if you haven't yet, go subscribe to New York Times Audio and you will get this beautiful hat sent in the mail to your door.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果您还没订阅，请订阅《纽约时报》音频，您就能收到这顶精美的帽子，我们会邮寄到您府上。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So if you live in the United States, you can subscribe and get your very own hard fork hat at nytimes.com slash hard fork hat.
sentences.zh: 如果您住在美国，订阅即可获得属于您的“硬分叉”帽子，网址是 nytimes.com/hardforkhat。

sentences.en: It's way more useful than a tote bag.
sentences.zh: 它比帆布袋实用多了。

sentences.en: And plus, you already have 100 tote bags.
sentences.zh: 再说，你已经有100个帆布袋了。

sentences.en: What do you need another tote bag for?
sentences.zh: 你还需要帆布袋干什么？

sentences.en: Go get a hat.
sentences.zh: 去弄顶帽子吧。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫（Natalie Kittroweff）。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: For years, Uber has said it's one of the safest ways to travel.
sentences.zh: 多年来，优步（Uber）一直声称它是最安全的出行方式之一。

sentences.en: But a Times investigation has found that behind closed doors, the company's been contending with a massive problem.
sentences.zh: 但《纽约时报》的一项调查发现，在不为人知的背后，该公司一直面临着一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: Hundreds of thousands of people reporting that they'd been sexually assaulted or harassed during Uber rides.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人报告称，他们在乘坐优步时遭到性侵或骚扰。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Emily Steele on what executives knew about the problem and how they failed to take certain steps that were supposed to make riders safer.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事艾米丽·斯蒂尔（Emily Steele）将讲述高管们对这一问题的了解，以及他们为何未能采取本应让乘客更安全的措施。

sentences.en: It's Friday, August 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月8日，星期五。

sentences.en: So Emily, you've covered sexual assault for The New York Times for years.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，你为《纽约时报》报道性侵议题已经很多年了。

sentences.en: You've won a Pulitzer for your Me Too coverage.
sentences.zh: 你还凭借“我也是”（Me Too）的报道获得了普利策奖。

sentences.en: And you've also covered safety issues in a number of industries.
sentences.zh: 你还报道过多个行业的安全问题。

sentences.en: Tell me how you arrived at looking at Uber, because I think this investigation kind of combines your two areas of expertise.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你是怎么开始关注优步的，因为我觉得这项调查结合了你的两个专业领域。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So it was back in March.
sentences.zh: 那是三月份的事了。

sentences.en: Someone had suggested that I look into Uber and to look into the company's issues with sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 有人建议我调查一下优步，看看该公司在性侵方面的问题。

sentences.en: And at first, I was skeptical.
sentences.zh: 起初，我持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: I thought, you know, everybody knows about Uber's raucous tech bro period.
sentences.zh: 我想，大家都知道优步那段喧闹的“科技兄弟”时期。

sentences.en: Everybody knew about the CEO, Travis Kalanick, who reigned over Uber during this wild time when there was scandal after scandal.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道首席执行官特拉维斯·卡兰尼克（Travis Kalanick），他在那段疯狂的时期统治着优步，当时丑闻接二连三。

sentences.en: There was a 2014 rape in India that made headlines, and the company came under scrutiny for how it handled that incident.
sentences.zh: 2014年印度发生了一起强奸案，登上了头条，公司因处理该事件的方式而受到审查。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There were also a lot of issues inside the company, where there was sexual harassment within the workplace.
sentences.zh: 公司内部也存在很多问题，职场中存在性骚扰。

sentences.en: Allegations were very prominent at the company during that time.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，公司内部的指控非常突出。

sentences.en: And then what happened was the company cleaned up.
sentences.zh: 后来，公司进行了整顿。

sentences.en: Travis Kalanick was pushed out of the company.
sentences.zh: 特拉维斯·卡兰尼克被赶出了公司。

sentences.en: Uber hired this new CEO.
sentences.zh: 优步聘请了这位新首席执行官。

sentences.en: His name was Dara Khosrowshahi.
sentences.zh: 他叫达拉·科斯罗萨西（Dara Khosrowshahi）。

sentences.en: He was the head of Expedia previously, and he was really seen as the grown-up who had come in to clean up this company's tech bro culture,
sentences.zh: 他之前是Expedia的负责人，他被视为那个进来清理公司“科技兄弟”文化的成年人，

sentences.en: to get this company ready for its initial public offering.
sentences.zh: 让公司为首次公开募股做好准备。

sentences.en: He introduced a new era, he said, of transparency and integrity and accountability.
sentences.zh: 他说，他开启了一个透明、诚信和问责的新时代。

sentences.en: And the company promises that they will put safety firSt.
sentences.zh: 公司承诺将安全放在首位。

sentences.en: The motto for the company has switched from super pumped to do the right thing, period.
sentences.zh: 公司的座右铭从“超级兴奋”变成了“做正确的事，句号”。

sentences.en: And publicly, it really seemed like the company had cleaned things up.
sentences.zh: 在公开场合，公司看起来确实已经清理干净了。

sentences.en: And so it made me wonder, is there a story here?
sentences.zh: 这让我不禁怀疑，这里面还有故事吗？

sentences.en: And what did you find?
sentences.zh: 你发现了什么？

sentences.en: So then I started to look, and I started to dig a little bit, and I saw that there were lawsuits against Uber all across the country.
sentences.zh: 于是我开始调查，稍微挖掘了一下，我发现全国各地都有针对优步的诉讼。

sentences.en: And I saw that there were these two proceedings that were consolidated in California.
sentences.zh: 我看到在加利福尼亚州合并了两个诉讼程序。

sentences.en: One in state court and one in federal court, where there were literally hundreds of lawsuits from people who had claimed that they had been assaulted
sentences.zh: 一个是州法院，一个是联邦法院，那里有成百上千起诉讼，来自声称自己遭到袭击

sentences.en: or harassed by their Uber drivers.
sentences.zh: 或被优步司机骚扰的人。

sentences.en: And there was a person who said that they were sexually assaulted, battered, raped, harassed, and attacked by their driver.
sentences.zh: 有一个人说他们被司机性侵、殴打、强奸、骚扰和攻击。

sentences.en: There was another complaint where somebody said that their Uber driver had thrown this woman's phone and purse out of the vehicle,
sentences.zh: 还有另一项投诉，有人说他们的优步司机把这位女士的手机和钱包扔出了车外，

sentences.en: pulled over, and started to do all this terrible stuff to her.
sentences.zh: 靠边停车，开始对她做各种可怕的事情。

sentences.en: Yikes.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And then I came across a story that was just horrifying.
sentences.zh: 然后我看到了一个令人毛骨悚然的故事。

sentences.en: It happened on a Thursday night in December in 2023.
sentences.zh: 那是2023年12月的一个周四晚上。

sentences.en: And there was a woman in Houston who called an Uber to come pick her up from an apartment complex.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿有一位女士叫了一辆优步，从一个公寓大楼接她。

sentences.en: So she was picked up at 8.53 p.m.
sentences.zh: 她在晚上8点53分上车。

sentences.en: She wanted to be dropped off at this house about 22 minutes away.
sentences.zh: 她想去大约22分钟路程外的一所房子。

sentences.en: But the trip diverged with an eight-minute stop near a gas station.
sentences.zh: 但行程偏离了路线，在加油站附近停留了八分钟。

sentences.en: At that point, Uber sent a notification to this woman.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，优步向这位女士发送了一条通知。

sentences.en: It's an automatic notification to check on her to say, are you okay?
sentences.zh: 这是一个自动通知，用来确认她的情况，问她还好吗？

sentences.en: She didn't respond.
sentences.zh: 她没有回应。

sentences.en: And then the ride continued to deviate from its route.
sentences.zh: 然后行程继续偏离路线。

sentences.en: And at 9.29 p.m., it stopped near a Motel 6.
sentences.zh: 晚上9点29分，车停在一家Motel 6附近。

sentences.en: Uber sent another notification to check on this woman.
sentences.zh: 优步又发了一条通知来确认这位女士的情况。

sentences.en: She didn't respond.
sentences.zh: 她没有回应。

sentences.en: And then four minutes later, Uber tries to contact her with a robocall.
sentences.zh: 四分钟后，优步试图通过自动语音电话联系她。

sentences.en: She doesn't pick up.
sentences.zh: 她没有接听。

sentences.en: And this trip remains active on Uber with no recorded movement until the driver marks it complete at 2.01 a.m.
sentences.zh: 这次行程在优步上一直处于活跃状态，没有记录到移动，直到司机在凌晨2点01分将其标记为完成。

sentences.en: About four hours later, this woman calls Uber, and she's frantic.
sentences.zh: 大约四个小时后，这位女士给优步打电话，她非常慌乱。

sentences.en: She said that she had been intoxicated.
sentences.zh: 她说她当时喝醉了。

sentences.en: She said that she had been taken to a hotel and raped by her Uber driver.
sentences.zh: 她说她被带到一家酒店，并被优步司机强奸了。

sentences.en: She said that she woke up in a hotel room with that driver, who then fled after she became frantic.
sentences.zh: 她说她在酒店房间醒来时，司机就在身边，在她变得慌乱后，司机逃跑了。

sentences.en: That is just a horrific story.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个可怕的故事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Uber banned the driver immediately after the incident.
sentences.zh: 所以优步在事件发生后立即封禁了该司机。

sentences.en: And I was able to get my hands on an internal investigation into what happened.
sentences.zh: 我设法拿到了一份关于事件经过的内部调查报告。

sentences.en: The driver had received two previous accusations of sexual misconduct against him for making inappropriate comments.
sentences.zh: 该司机此前曾因发表不当言论而受到过两次性行为不端的指控。

sentences.en: And three automated attempts to try to get in touch with this rider had gone unanswered.
sentences.zh: 而且三次试图联系这位乘客的自动尝试都没有得到回应。

sentences.en: And it says in this report, it says, quote, are our actions or lack of actions defensible?
sentences.zh: 报告中写道，引用：“我们的行为或缺乏行动是站得住脚的吗？”

sentences.en: And what was really scary is that she wasn't alone.
sentences.zh: 真正可怕的是，她并不是唯一一个。

sentences.en: As I started to look more and more into this, I saw case after case after case after case.
sentences.zh: 当我开始深入调查时，我看到了一个又一个的案例。

sentences.en: And so I thought, gosh, I don't think people know about this.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，天哪，我觉得人们根本不知道这件事。

sentences.en: This is happening in Illinois, in Maryland, in North Carolina, in Colorado, Nevada, Minnesota,
sentences.zh: 这种情况发生在伊利诺伊州、马里兰州、北卡罗来纳州、科罗拉多州、内华达州、明尼苏达州、

sentences.en: California, Florida, just like all across the country.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州、佛罗里达州，简直遍布全国。

sentences.en: And the claims were recent.
sentences.zh: 而且这些指控都是近期的。

sentences.en: These weren't claims from 2014.
sentences.zh: 这些不是2014年的指控。

sentences.en: They weren't claims from 2018.
sentences.zh: 也不是2018年的指控。

sentences.en: They were claims from 2023, 2024, 2021, 2022.
It was recent stuff.
sentences.zh: 都是最近的事情。

sentences.en: And so it made me wonder, how big is this problem?
sentences.zh: 这让我不禁怀疑，这个问题有多严重？

sentences.en: What is the scope of this problem?
sentences.zh: 这个问题的范围有多大？

sentences.en: What does the company know?
sentences.zh: 公司知道什么？

sentences.en: What have they done about it?
sentences.zh: 他们对此做了什么？

sentences.en: And what have they not done about it?
sentences.zh: 他们又没做什么？

sentences.en: How do you go about getting to the bottom of those questions?
sentences.zh: 你是如何查清这些问题的真相的？

sentences.en: That was a really big challenge.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常大的挑战。

sentences.en: I learned initially that there was no central database that collects all of these reports of sexual assault in the ride share industry.
sentences.zh: 我最初了解到，共享出行行业没有一个中央数据库来收集所有这些性侵报告。

sentences.en: So I thought, okay, maybe I can build my own.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，好吧，也许我可以自己建立一个。

sentences.en: And I submitted freedom of information requests to cities all across the country to say how many
sentences.zh: 我向全国各地的城市提交了信息自由请求，询问有多少

sentences.en: police reports, how many complaints of sexual assault do these different municipalities receive?
sentences.zh: 警察报告，这些不同的城市收到了多少性侵投诉？

sentences.en: And that is a long process.
sentences.zh: 那是一个漫长的过程。

sentences.en: And so I submitted those requests and then kind of kept digging.
sentences.zh: 所以我提交了这些请求，然后继续挖掘。

sentences.en: And then I talked to a lot of sources.
sentences.zh: 然后我采访了很多消息来源。

sentences.en: And what people said was that the place where I could get all of this information would be Uber, that Uber would know how many reports of assault were happening on its platform.
sentences.zh: 人们说，我能获取所有这些信息的地方就是优步，优步会知道其平台上发生了多少起性侵报告。

sentences.en: Uber collects all of that information.
sentences.zh: 优步收集了所有这些信息。

sentences.en: And so I was determined to figure out how I could get my hands on that information.
sentences.zh: 所以我下定决心要弄清楚如何才能拿到这些信息。

sentences.en: You got to go to the source.
sentences.zh: 你得去找源头。

sentences.en: I had to get the data.
sentences.zh: 我必须拿到数据。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it sounds like you did somehow.
sentences.zh: 听起来你确实以某种方式拿到了。

sentences.en: I did, somehow.
sentences.zh: 我确实拿到了，以某种方式。

sentences.en: Obviously, I can't say how I got this information.
sentences.zh: 显然，我不能说我是怎么得到这些信息的。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Over the course of this reporting, I was able to get my hands on literally thousands of pages of internal company documents.
sentences.zh: 在报道过程中，我设法拿到了数千页的公司内部文件。

sentences.en: These are emails.
sentences.zh: 这些是电子邮件。

sentences.en: They are Slack messages.
sentences.zh: 它们是Slack消息。

sentences.en: They are PowerPoint presentations.
sentences.zh: 它们是PowerPoint演示文稿。

sentences.en: They are reports and other documents.
sentences.zh: 它们是报告和其他文件。

sentences.en: Hundreds of these documents have been filed in court under seal.
sentences.zh: 数百份这些文件已在法庭上密封存档。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And what do you see when you're looking at these documents?
sentences.zh: 当你查看这些文件时，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: So one of the first things that catches my eye when I'm looking at these documents is a spreadsheet.
sentences.zh: 当我查看这些文件时，首先引起我注意的是一张电子表格。

sentences.en: And it says Uber trips with reports of sexual assault or sexual misconduct in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 上面写着“美国优步行程中涉及性侵或性行为不端的报告”。

sentences.en: And what it says is that Uber received a report of sexual assault or sexual misconduct in the United States almost every eight minutes on average between 2017 and 2022.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，2017年至2022年间，优步在美国平均每八分钟就收到一份性侵或性行为不端的报告。

sentences.en: One report to Uber of sexual misconduct or assault every eight minutes, what does that amount to?
sentences.zh: 每八分钟就有一份关于性行为不端或性侵的报告，这加起来是多少？

sentences.en: So the total number for that period is 400,181.
sentences.zh: 该期间的总数为400,181起。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That is much more than what the company has publicly disclosed.
sentences.zh: 这比公司公开披露的要多得多。

sentences.en: Publicly, the company has said that they had 12,522 accounts of serious sexual assault on the platform during the same time period.
sentences.zh: 公开场合，公司曾表示，在同一时期，平台上发生了12,522起严重性侵事件。

sentences.en: But Uber had not revealed the total number of sexual assault and sexual misconduct reports that it had received.
sentences.zh: 但优步没有透露其收到的性侵和性行为不端报告的总数。

sentences.en: Okay, so this is a difference basically between what Uber is saying is serious sexual assault and this bigger,
sentences.zh: 好的，所以这基本上是优步所说的严重性侵与这个更大的数字之间的区别，

sentences.en: far bigger number that includes all sexual assaults and claims of harassment.
sentences.zh: 这个数字大得多，包括了所有的性侵和骚扰指控。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Uber tracks 21 different categories of sexual assault and sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 优步追踪21种不同类别的性侵和性行为不端。

sentences.en: What it reveals publicly is five of what it considers the most serious categories of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 它公开披露的是它认为最严重的五类性侵犯。

sentences.en: And this number, this 400,000 figure represents all of the cases of sexual assault and sexual misconduct on the platform.
sentences.zh: 而这个数字，即40万这一数据，代表了该平台上所有的性侵犯和性骚扰案件。

sentences.en: Did you ask Uber about this?
sentences.zh: 你问过优步（Uber）这件事吗？

sentences.en: What did they say?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么说的？

sentences.en: I did ask Uber about this.
sentences.zh: 我确实问过优步。

sentences.en: And what Uber has said is that there is no tolerable level of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 优步的说法是，性侵犯是绝对不能容忍的。

sentences.en: And they did point out that about 75% of those 400,000 reports were quote-unquote less serious in nature.
sentences.zh: 他们确实指出，那40万份报告中约有75%属于所谓的“性质较轻”的范畴。

sentences.en: They were things like making comments about somebody's appearance, flirting, or using explicit language.
sentences.zh: 这些情况包括对某人的外貌发表评论、调情或使用露骨的语言。

sentences.en: The company also said that those 400,000 reports had not been audited by the company,
sentences.zh: 该公司还表示，这40万份报告并未经过公司审计，

sentences.en: so they could include incorrect reports or also fraudulent reports that were submitted by people who wanted a refund.
sentences.zh: 因此其中可能包含不准确的报告，或者是为了退款而提交的虚假报告。

sentences.en: Okay, so they're saying 75% of that 400,000 is less serious.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以他们说那40万份报告中有75%属于较轻微的情况。

sentences.en: But I guess, I mean, to me, you know, 25% of that amount is still like 100,000 claiMs.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，对我来说，你知道，这个数字的25%仍然相当于10万起投诉。

sentences.en: That's a big number.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很大的数字。

sentences.en: What Uber says is millions of people hail a car in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 优步表示，在美国，每天有数百万人叫车，

sentences.en: every single day and that the vast majority of those trips go without incident.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数行程都没有发生任何事故。

sentences.en: They say 99.9% of rides occur without any report, any safety report of any kind.
sentences.zh: 他们说99.9%的行程没有任何报告，没有任何形式的安全报告。

sentences.en: And they say that because Uber operates on such a large scale, that you're going to see the best and worst of society show up on those rides.
sentences.zh: 他们还说，因为优步的运营规模如此之大，你会在这些行程中看到社会最好和最坏的一面。

sentences.en: But the thing is that even a fraction of a percent can translate into many, many attacks.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，即使是百分之几的比例，也可能意味着成千上万次袭击。

sentences.en: So it sounds like you're seeing the answer to your first question that you came to these documents with, which is what's the scope of this problem?
sentences.zh: 所以听起来你已经找到了你带着这些文件去寻找的第一个问题的答案，那就是这个问题的规模有多大？

sentences.en: And that answer is it is big.
sentences.zh: 答案是：规模很大。

sentences.en: It's a big problem.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大问题。

sentences.en: What did you learn about your second question, which is what did Uber know and when did they know it?
sentences.zh: 关于你的第二个问题，即优步知道什么以及何时知道的，你了解到了什么？

sentences.en: What did they do?
sentences.zh: 他们做了什么？

sentences.en: So as I'm paging through these documents, it's literally thousands and thousands and thousands of pages.
sentences.zh: 当我翻阅这些文件时，那真的是成千上万页的内容。

sentences.en: And what I found was that Uber not only was aware of this problem, but they actually were studying incidents of sexual violence by 2016.
sentences.zh: 我发现优步不仅意识到了这个问题，而且早在2016年就开始研究性暴力事件了。

sentences.en: And that year, there were data scientists in the company, and they saw that sexual assault followed distinct patterns on the platform.
sentences.zh: 那一年，公司里的数据科学家发现，性侵犯在平台上呈现出明显的模式。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: What are the patterns?
sentences.zh: 这些模式是什么？

sentences.en: So women most often are the victims, whether they are passengers or drivers.
sentences.zh: 女性最常成为受害者，无论是作为乘客还是司机。

sentences.en: The attacks typically occur late at night and on the weekend with pickups originating near a bar.
sentences.zh: 袭击通常发生在深夜和周末，且上车地点多在酒吧附近。

sentences.en: In the vast majority of these cases, the offenders are men, either drivers or passengers.
sentences.zh: 在绝大多数此类案件中，加害者都是男性，无论是司机还是乘客。

sentences.en: And those men, both the drivers and passengers, have records of sexual misconduct complaints on Uber and low ratings.
sentences.zh: 而这些男性，无论是司机还是乘客，在优步上都有性骚扰投诉记录和低评分。

sentences.en: And then intoxicated passengers are especially vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 此外，醉酒的乘客尤其脆弱。

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有意思。

sentences.en: We're not just talking about female passengers, right?
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的不只是女性乘客，对吧？

sentences.en: It's also female drivers who are experiencing harassment and assault at the hands of passengers.
sentences.zh: 女性司机也会在乘客手中遭受骚扰和袭击。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that was something that wasn't an issue that I immediately knew about, but it was something that I learned about in this reporting, that drivers are victims, too.
sentences.zh: 这不是我一开始就知道的问题，但我在这次报道中了解到，司机也是受害者。

sentences.en: It's not just passengers.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是乘客。

sentences.en: And one of the other really interesting things that I found is that for years, teams inside of Uber have tested tools that they found were effective at making trips safer.
sentences.zh: 我发现的另一个非常有趣的事情是，多年来，优步内部的团队一直在测试他们认为能有效提高行程安全性的工具。

sentences.en: But the company delayed or did not require its drivers to adopt some of those most promising prograMs.
sentences.zh: 但公司推迟或并未要求其司机采用其中一些最有前景的项目。

sentences.en: And they also didn't warn passengers about the factors that it linked to attacks.
sentences.zh: 他们也没有就与袭击相关的因素向乘客发出警告。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘温娜（Wynna Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基（Sam Azersky）。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”（promesthesia）的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Emily, let's talk about these tools that you said Uber developed that the company itself thought could kind of help prevent sexual assault during rides.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，我们来谈谈你提到的那些优步开发的、公司自身认为有助于预防行程中性侵犯的工具。

sentences.en: Tell me about those solutions.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说这些解决方案。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I think there are three worth talking about.
sentences.zh: 好的，我认为有三个值得讨论。

sentences.en: One was designed to be part of the sophisticated algorithm that happens behind the scenes when you open up the Uber app and tap to request a ride.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是设计作为复杂算法的一部分，当你打开优步应用并点击叫车时，它会在后台运行。

sentences.en: There were teams of data scientists inside of Uber who, for years,
sentences.zh: 优步内部有数据科学家团队，多年来，

sentences.en: worked to develop this special model to forecast which matches between a driver and a passenger might lead to a sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 他们致力于开发这种特殊的模型，以预测司机和乘客之间的哪些匹配可能会导致性侵犯。

sentences.en: How do they do that?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: So there was this one presentation that I looked at.
sentences.zh: 我看过一份演示文稿。

sentences.en: It was a 2017 presentation.
sentences.zh: 那是2017年的演示文稿。

sentences.en: It was called Preventing Sexual Assault.
sentences.zh: 标题是《预防性侵犯》。

sentences.en: And this document detailed how the company could use 43 different predictors.
sentences.zh: 这份文件详细说明了公司如何利用43种不同的预测因子。

sentences.en: Things like reporting a creepy driver, safety incident reports, geographic information, like the number of bars near a pickup.
sentences.zh: 比如举报令人毛骨悚然的司机、安全事件报告、地理信息，例如上车点附近的酒吧数量。

sentences.en: And this data-driven machine learning model does some sort of sophisticated calculation to score the risks of pairings between drivers and passengers.
sentences.zh: 这种数据驱动的机器学习模型会进行某种复杂的计算，来评估司机和乘客之间配对的风险。

sentences.en: And the company actually quietly tested this program in Los Angeles in 2018.
sentences.zh: 公司实际上在2018年于洛杉矶悄悄测试了这个项目。

sentences.en: And what Uber found is that this program could correctly anticipate 15% of sexual assaults on trips that were using Uber's basic ride-hailing option.
sentences.zh: 优步发现，该项目可以准确预测使用优步基础叫车选项的行程中15%的性侵犯事件。

sentences.en: Sorry, so are you saying that Uber was running a safety test on, like,
sentences.zh: 抱歉，你是说优步在进行安全测试，比如，

sentences.en: live customers where the company is accurately predicting ahead of time that someone is likely to be assaulted or harassed?
sentences.zh: 在真实客户身上，公司提前准确预测出某人很可能会受到袭击或骚扰？

sentences.en: That's what these documents show.
sentences.zh: 这些文件就是这么显示的。

sentences.en: They show that the company was testing this model in shadow mode and not acting on it.
sentences.zh: 它们显示公司在“影子模式”下测试了这个模型，但没有采取行动。

sentences.en: An internal presentation a few months later on this tool called it potentially the most effective intervention for preventing sexual assaults.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，一份关于该工具的内部演示文稿称其为预防性侵犯最有效的潜在干预措施。

sentences.en: So what do they do with it?
sentences.zh: 那他们用它做了什么？

sentences.en: So what I learned is that this tool has been up and running in the United States since 2022.
sentences.zh: 我了解到的是，该工具自2022年起已在美国投入使用。

sentences.en: So it's part of that system that Uber now uses to respond when you request a trip.
sentences.zh: 所以它是优步现在在你叫车时用来响应的系统的一部分。

sentences.en: And it has long been considered a trade secret.
sentences.zh: 它长期以来一直被视为商业机密。

sentences.en: At the company and the company hasn't spoken publicly about this technology until now.
sentences.zh: 在公司内部，而且直到现在公司都没有公开谈论过这项技术。

sentences.en: The way that this tool works, it first determines the risk of potential pairings between drivers and passengers.
sentences.zh: 这个工具的工作方式是，首先确定司机和乘客之间潜在配对的风险。

sentences.en: And then it uses those scores to try to select the best match.
sentences.zh: 然后利用这些评分来尝试选择最佳匹配。

sentences.en: And so it will prioritize rides that are safer and downrank pairings between drivers and passengers that are less safe.
sentences.zh: 因此，它会优先考虑更安全的行程，并降低那些安全性较低的司机与乘客配对的优先级。

sentences.en: So the rides that are determined as risky are deprioritized.
sentences.zh: 所以被判定为有风险的行程会被降低优先级。

sentences.en: They're put at the end of the line of all the options that you might get when you call an Uber, right?
sentences.zh: 它们会被排在你叫优步时可能获得的所有选项的最后，对吧？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: But what I found in all of these records was a document from 2024.
sentences.zh: 但我在这所有记录中发现了一份2024年的文件。

sentences.en: And it identified a problem with this system.
sentences.zh: 它指出了该系统的一个问题。

sentences.en: It said that Uber was still dispatching trips that it had identified as high risk.
sentences.zh: 它说优步仍在派送它已识别为高风险的行程。

sentences.en: So why not just eliminate those pairings?
sentences.zh: 那为什么不直接消除这些配对呢？

sentences.en: Why not, for example, kick off those drivers or riders that are seen as potentially, you know, aggressive?
sentences.zh: 为什么不，比如说，踢掉那些被视为可能具有攻击性的司机或乘客？

sentences.en: So Uber does say that it bans drivers and passengers that are accused of serious sexual assault or a number of lower-level complaints.
sentences.zh: 优步确实表示，它会封禁被指控严重性侵犯或有多次较低级别投诉的司机和乘客。

sentences.en: And what it also says is that this technology cannot reliably predict whether an individual pairing or trip will result in an incident or not.
sentences.zh: 它还表示，这项技术无法可靠地预测某个特定的配对或行程是否会导致事件发生。

sentences.en: And Uber also said that if they were to unilaterally block all sorts of trips, like requests from bars late at night, that that could leave many people stranded on the street.
sentences.zh: 优步还表示，如果他们单方面阻止所有类型的行程，比如深夜从酒吧发出的请求，那可能会让许多人滞留在街头。

sentences.en: And it could encourage them to drive drunk or walk home unsafely.
sentences.zh: 这可能会鼓励他们酒后驾车或不安全地步行回家。

sentences.en: So they're making the argument that, look, this tool might be useful, but it isn't completely predictive.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的论点是，看，这个工具可能有用，但它并非完全可预测。

sentences.en: And trying to mitigate the risk on any one pairing could actually lead to more dangerous scenarios.
sentences.zh: 试图减轻任何单一配对的风险实际上可能导致更危险的情况。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what's the second solution that the company looked at?
sentences.zh: 那么公司研究的第二个解决方案是什么？

sentences.en: So another solution that the company has been exploring for years is the idea that you could pair women drivers with women passengers.
sentences.zh: 公司多年来一直在探索的另一个解决方案是，你可以将女性司机与女性乘客进行匹配。

sentences.en: Theoretically, the people least likely to assault each other.
sentences.zh: 理论上，这些人最不可能互相侵犯。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The company first introduced this option in Saudi Arabia in 2019 with the choice for women drivers to select women passengers.
sentences.zh: 公司于2019年首次在沙特阿拉伯推出了这个选项，让女性司机可以选择女性乘客。

sentences.en: But Uber held off introducing this as an option in the United States.
sentences.zh: 但优步推迟了在美国引入这一选项。

sentences.en: How come?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Well, so what's really interesting, though, is as recently as last fall, executives greenlit a pilot for a women matching option in the United States.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常有趣的是，就在去年秋天，高管们批准了在美国进行女性匹配选项的试点。

sentences.en: And it was supposed to start in November.
sentences.zh: 原定于11月开始。

sentences.en: And then days after Donald Trump is elected president, executives decided to hold off.
sentences.zh: 但在唐纳德·特朗普当选总统几天后，高管们决定推迟。

sentences.en: And there was an internal document that said, this is not the right environment to launch.
sentences.zh: 有一份内部文件称，现在不是推出的合适环境。

sentences.en: And we want to take a beat to reassess our timing.
sentences.zh: 我们想花点时间重新评估我们的时机。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I'm just wondering, overall, is this really a long-term solution to the problem?
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，总的来说，这真的是解决这个问题的长期方案吗？

sentences.en: Because there aren't that many women Uber drivers.
sentences.zh: 因为女性优步司机并不多。

sentences.en: At least in my experience, there's way more men driving for the platform.
sentences.zh: 至少在我的经验中，平台上男性司机要多得多。

sentences.en: So one of the big issues or one of the big hurdles to introducing this option is Uber had to have enough women drivers.
sentences.zh: 所以引入这个选项的一大问题或一大障碍是，优步必须有足够的女性司机。

sentences.en: And there was an internal document that I found that said that several high-profile assaults had made it difficult to attract those women to drive for Uber.
sentences.zh: 我发现的一份内部文件称，几起备受瞩目的袭击事件使得吸引这些女性为优步开车变得困难。

sentences.en: It said, safety has ranked as one of the top reasons for prospective female drivers to not join Uber and for current female drivers to not drive during certain hours of the day.
sentences.zh: 文件称，安全性已成为潜在女性司机不加入优步以及现有女性司机不在一天中某些时段开车的主要原因之一。

sentences.en: There also are other things to think about.
sentences.zh: 还有其他事情需要考虑。

sentences.en: People inside the company worried, if we introduce this, are we telegraphing that other Uber rides are not safe?
sentences.zh: 公司内部的人担心，如果我们引入这个，是不是在暗示其他优步行程不安全？

sentences.en: There were worries that if this option were to cost more, would that be considered a pink tax?
sentences.zh: 有人担心如果这个选项成本更高，会被视为“粉红税”。

sentences.en: And most importantly, there was the fear of gender discrimination and other lawsuits that the company calculated could cost more than $100 million.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，公司担心性别歧视和其他诉讼，据估算这些诉讼可能耗资超过1亿美元。

sentences.en: But despite all of that, the company did announce at the end of July that it was going to start testing women-matching options in Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Detroit.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，公司还是在7月底宣布，将开始在洛杉矶、旧金山和底特律测试女性匹配选项。

sentences.en: It sounds like in the case of both of these first two options, you have them rolled out in one case without us knowing.
sentences.zh: 听起来在前两个选项中，你都是在没有我们知情的情况下推出的。

sentences.en: In the other case, there was a long delay before it happened.
sentences.zh: 在另一种情况下，在它发生之前有很长的延迟。

sentences.en: What about the third solution?
sentences.zh: 第三个解决方案是什么？

sentences.en: So the third solution is dash caMs.
sentences.zh: 第三个解决方案是行车记录仪。

sentences.en: As early as 2014, the company had been exploring the idea of using cameras in cars.
sentences.zh: 早在2014年，公司就开始探索在车内安装摄像头的想法。

sentences.en: And then the new CEO comes in, Dara Khashrashahi, and he outlines this vision of installing inexpensive cameras in Uber cars that would record trips by default.
sentences.zh: 然后新任首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西（Dara Khosrowshahi）上任，他提出了一个愿景，即在优步车内安装廉价摄像头，默认记录行程。

sentences.en: Well, employees studied this plan, and they found not only would it be feasible and cost-effective, but it also was likely to reduce sexual misconduct and help drivers.
sentences.zh: 员工研究了这个计划，发现它不仅可行且具有成本效益，而且还可能减少性骚扰并帮助司机。

sentences.en: But the company didn't do it.
sentences.zh: 但公司没有这样做。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Largely because installing cameras in Uber cars would conflict with the company's business model.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上是因为在优步车内安装摄像头会与公司的商业模式相冲突。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: So by design, Uber drivers are classified as independent contractors, not employees.
sentences.zh: 按照设计，优步司机被归类为独立承包商，而非员工。

sentences.en: That means that Uber and other gig economy companies can avoid paying significant costs that are associated with traditional employment.
sentences.zh: 这意味着优步和其他零工经济公司可以避免支付与传统就业相关的大量成本。

sentences.en: So that's things like minimum wage, it's overtime, it's employee benefits, it's time for rest breaks.
sentences.zh: 比如最低工资、加班费、员工福利、休息时间等。

sentences.en: This is the key to Uber's business model.
sentences.zh: 这是优步商业模式的关键。

sentences.en: And Uber goes to great lengths not to treat drivers like employees.
sentences.zh: 优步竭尽全力不把司机当作员工对待。

sentences.en: And so they do things like limit trainings and not require certain equipment like cameras to be installed in cars.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会做一些事情，比如限制培训，不要求在车内安装摄像头等特定设备。

sentences.en: This seems pretty critical to the whole story.
sentences.zh: 这对于整个故事来说似乎非常关键。

sentences.en: I mean, preserving that contracting model is obviously so important to Uber.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，维护那种承包模式对优步来说显然非常重要。

sentences.en: You can imagine how much their costs would go up if suddenly they had all of these drivers as employees.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，如果突然间所有这些司机都成了员工，他们的成本会增加多少。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's crucial to the company's business.
sentences.zh: 这对公司的业务至关重要。

sentences.en: And what Uber says is that it offers the option through its apps for drivers and passengers to record audio and for drivers to use their phones and the front-facing camera on their phone to record video.
sentences.zh: 优步表示，它通过应用程序为司机和乘客提供了录音选项，并允许司机使用手机及其前置摄像头录制视频。

sentences.en: But that the decision not to require video recording had as much to do with very practical challenges and privacy concerns as it did with driver's employment classification.
sentences.zh: 但决定不强制要求录制视频，既与非常实际的挑战和隐私担忧有关，也与司机的雇佣分类有关。

sentences.en: So Uber has essentially come up with a hybrid solution.
sentences.zh: 所以优步本质上提出了一种混合解决方案。

sentences.en: And the advantage for Uber is that those options preserve the company's business model.
sentences.zh: 而对优步来说，优势在于这些选项维护了公司的商业模式。

sentences.en: Just to explore for a second what I imagine that the company's position is, if the drivers are not employees of Uber, is it fair, actually,
sentences.zh: 我想稍微探讨一下公司的立场，如果司机不是优步的员工，那么，

sentences.en: to hold the company responsible for what happens in their cars?
sentences.zh: 让公司对发生在他们车内的事情负责，这公平吗？

sentences.en: You know, it's like, I think we all know that when we order an Uber, we're getting into a private car that's being driven by a gig driver.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想我们都知道，当我们叫优步时，我们坐进的是一辆由零工司机驾驶的私家车。

sentences.en: Sure, they've been vetted to some extent by the company, but Uber is just the matchmaker, right?
sentences.zh: 没错，他们确实在一定程度上经过了公司的审查，但优步（Uber）只是个牵线搭桥的中间人，对吧？

sentences.en: They aren't literally providing the service.
sentences.zh: 他们并不是真正提供服务的一方。

sentences.en: You are right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: That's the company's position.
sentences.zh: 这就是公司的立场。

sentences.en: The company has called those lawsuits a legally baseless attempt to hold it liable for the extremely rare and unforeseeable criminal acts of independent drivers.
sentences.zh: 公司称这些诉讼在法律上毫无根据，试图让公司为独立司机极其罕见且不可预见的犯罪行为承担责任。

sentences.en: In some cases, the company has even turned around and sued those drivers that were accused of assault, essentially saying that if those allegations were true,
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，公司甚至反过来起诉那些被指控袭击的司机，本质上是说如果这些指控属实，

sentences.en: that the drivers had violated their agreements with the company.
sentences.zh: 那么这些司机就违反了他们与公司签署的协议。

sentences.en: But the people suing Uber claim that the company is responsible for the misconduct of their drivers.
sentences.zh: 但起诉优步的人声称，公司应对其司机的不当行为负责。

sentences.en: They say that the company is more interested in growth than protecting its passengers.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，公司对增长的兴趣远大于对乘客安全的保护。

sentences.en: And then they say that the company has gone to great lengths to cover up what they've described as a sexual assault epidemic.
sentences.zh: 他们还表示，公司为了掩盖他们所描述的“性侵泛滥”问题，可谓费尽心机。

sentences.en: In just thinking about the three solutions that we've talked about, it does seem as though in each case there was an aspect of this that the company wasn't really publicizing,
sentences.zh: 回想我们讨论过的三个解决方案，似乎在每种情况下，公司都有一方面的内容没有真正公开，

sentences.en: either the problem itself or the solution in some cases.
sentences.zh: 有时是问题本身，有时是解决方案。

sentences.en: And I guess I'm wondering why you think that is, because it does seem like something that, you know, riders would have wanted to know about.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你为什么会这么认为，因为这看起来确实是乘客们想要了解的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in my reporting, that was something that was really striking to me, because at the same time that Uber was studying this problem, developing tools for this problem,
sentences.zh: 在我的报道中，这一点非常令我震惊，因为优步在研究这个问题、开发相关工具的同时，

sentences.en: they also were deploying some pretty aggressive media campaigns to publicize that Uber is one of the safest options for travel.
sentences.zh: 他们也在开展一些相当激进的媒体宣传活动，宣扬优步是出行最安全的选择之一。

sentences.en: And to highlight these risks could present a problem.
sentences.zh: 而强调这些风险可能会带来问题。

sentences.en: It could say, hey, we might not be as safe as what we said we were.
sentences.zh: 这等于在说：嘿，我们可能并不像我们宣称的那样安全。

sentences.en: So you're saying basically one of the reasons the company might not be telling people about this is that it could freak people out.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，公司可能不告诉人们这件事的原因之一，是怕吓到他们。

sentences.en: It could scare them away.
sentences.zh: 这可能会把他们吓跑。

sentences.en: It could contradict that message of safety.
sentences.zh: 这可能会与“安全”这一宣传口径相矛盾。

sentences.en: And the idea of warning customers about the patterns linked to attacks has actually caused some rifts inside of the company.
sentences.zh: 而且，关于是否要向客户警告与袭击相关的模式，实际上在公司内部引起了一些分歧。

sentences.en: There have been people who have said internally, look, we need to tell people.
sentences.zh: 内部有人说，看，我们需要告诉大家。

sentences.en: We need to tell them the rides that are the most risky are the ones when people are getting picked up by a bar, if it's a single woman in the backseat alone, if she's intoxicated.
sentences.zh: 我们需要告诉他们，风险最高的乘车情况是：在酒吧接人，如果后座只有一名女性，且她喝醉了的话。

sentences.en: And the company ultimately decided not to.
sentences.zh: 但公司最终决定不这么做。

sentences.en: I found a presentation discussing whether or not the company should include day or time patterns about when these incidents occur.
sentences.zh: 我发现了一份演示文稿，讨论公司是否应该包含这些事件发生的日期或时间模式。

sentences.en: And there's a slide in this presentation that basically says if we include this information, it will lead to fewer people riding in Ubers.
sentences.zh: 演示文稿中有一页幻灯片基本上写着：如果我们包含这些信息，会导致乘坐优步的人数减少。

sentences.en: So directly saying the quiet part out loud, this could hurt our business.
sentences.zh: 所以这是直接把不能说的秘密说了出来：这可能会损害我们的业务。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It does seem as though a lot of this comes down to transparency.
sentences.zh: 看来这一切归根结底还是透明度的问题。

sentences.en: I mean, whether Uber is liable is sort of for the courts to decide.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，优步是否有责任，那是法院需要裁决的事。

sentences.en: But the fact that the company is really not making this public, isn't being honest with us about what the risks are, and then letting us decide if we want to get in the car.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，公司确实没有公开这些信息，没有就风险问题对我们坦诚相待，从而让我们自己决定是否要上车。

sentences.en: I mean, that feels like a really important question in all of this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这在所有这些问题中似乎是一个非常重要的问题。

sentences.en: And that's something that came up over and over again in my reporting is how much does the company know?
sentences.zh: 这也是我在报道中反复提到的一个问题：公司到底知道多少？

sentences.en: How much has it told us about what it knows?
sentences.zh: 对于它所知道的事情，它告诉了我们多少？

sentences.en: And what should Uber tell us about what it knows?
sentences.zh: 优步应该告诉我们它所知道的什么？

sentences.en: And if people know about the harm and they know about the risks, they can take steps to protect themselves and to protect others.
sentences.zh: 如果人们了解这些伤害和风险，他们就能采取措施保护自己和他人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So maybe they won't take an Uber by themselves when they're drunk coming home from a bar.
sentences.zh: 所以也许他们就不会在喝醉了从酒吧回家时独自乘坐优步了。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Maybe they won't put their drunk friend in the backseat of a car.
sentences.zh: 也许他们就不会让喝醉的朋友独自坐在后座了。

sentences.en: Maybe they will turn on the options to record the audio of those rides.
sentences.zh: 也许他们会开启行程录音功能。

sentences.en: You see the stats and you see the data and you see how there were 6.3 billion rides that occurred during this time period when all of these assaults occurred.
sentences.zh: 你看看统计数据，看看这些资料，你会发现所有这些袭击事件发生期间，总共发生了63亿次行程。

sentences.en: That's just a fraction of a percent of rides that end in serious incidents.
sentences.zh: 严重事故在行程中所占的比例微乎其微。

sentences.en: But when you look at those individual incidents, it's stories of people whose lives have been upended by one ride.
sentences.zh: 但当你审视那些个别事件时，你会发现那是人们的生活被一次行程彻底改变的故事。

sentences.en: And they're facing a lot of trauma and a lot of pain.
sentences.zh: 他们正面临着巨大的创伤和痛苦。

sentences.en: And the question is, if they had had more information, would they have been better able to protect themselves?
sentences.zh: 问题是，如果他们掌握了更多信息，他们是否能更好地保护自己？

sentences.en: And did the company do enough to protect its customers?
sentences.zh: 公司是否尽到了保护客户的责任？

sentences.en: Emily, thanks so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: In an interview on Fox News on Thursday, before the security cabinet met, Netanyahu said Israel did not want to maintain permanent control of Gaza or govern it.
sentences.zh: 周四在接受福克斯新闻采访时，在安全内阁开会前，内塔尼亚胡表示以色列不想对加沙保持永久控制或进行治理。

sentences.en: The security cabinet also approved several principles for ending the war, including the return of all remaining hostages, the disarming of Hamas,
sentences.zh: 安全内阁还批准了结束战争的几项原则，包括遣返所有剩余人质、解除哈马斯的武装，

sentences.en: and the establishment of an alternative governing body in Gaza that doesn't include Hamas or the Palestinian Authority.
sentences.zh: 以及在加沙建立一个不包括哈马斯或巴勒斯坦权力机构的替代管理机构。

sentences.en: It'll likely take the military days, if not weeks,
sentences.zh: 军方可能需要几天甚至几周的时间，

sentences.en: to call up reserve forces and to allow time for the forced evacuation of tens of thousands of Palestinians from the new areas of combat.
sentences.zh: 来征召预备役部队，并留出时间强制疏散数万名来自新战斗区域的巴勒斯坦人。

sentences.en: And, President Trump has announced he's nominating Stephen Myron, his top economic advisor, to serve as a governor at the Federal Reserve.
sentences.zh: 另外，特朗普总统宣布提名他的首席经济顾问斯蒂芬·迈伦担任美联储理事。

sentences.en: Myron has been a staunch defender of Trump's economic policies and has echoed the president's criticism of Fed Chair Jerome Powell for not lowering interest rates.
sentences.zh: 迈伦一直是特朗普经济政策的坚定捍卫者，并附和了总统对美联储主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔不降息的批评。

sentences.en: Trump made it clear that Myron would serve in the position temporarily if confirmed by the Senate, though it's possible that he could stay on.
sentences.zh: 特朗普明确表示，如果获得参议院确认，迈伦将暂时担任该职位，尽管他也有可能留任。

sentences.en: The White House is planning to run a separate process to nominate someone to fill the seat starting in February.
sentences.zh: 白宫计划启动一个单独的程序，提名人选从二月份开始填补该席位。

sentences.en: And that person could potentially be elevated to become the chair of the central bank next year when Powell's term expires.
sentences.zh: 而那个人明年在鲍威尔任期届满时，有可能被提拔为央行行长。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Olivia Natt, Jessica Chung, and Eric Krupke.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由奥利维亚·纳特、杰西卡·钟和埃里克·克鲁普克制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Maria Byrne and Michael Benoit.
sentences.zh: 由玛丽亚·伯恩和迈克尔·伯努瓦编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marion Lozano and Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽昂·洛萨诺和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝得烂醉才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或任何你喜欢的播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
